title: 第15章 道友们谁懂啊他分明是在觊觎我的美貌第16章 观玄阁战天塔
content_zh:
里面有五颗玄气丹，都是天玄宗下发的普通货色，也许是那几个小弟孝敬丁铁的，现在让他捡了便宜。
这些丹药，林玄曾经求之不得，现在却提不起任何兴趣了。
只有经过天地洪炉祭炼之后，才能入他的口。
林玄收起丹药，继续向深山进发。
在一处僻静的山谷中，他花费几个呼吸的时间，将五颗玄气丹祭炼了一遍，得到了五颗九道金纹丹药。
“黄阶九品金纹玄气丹！”
林玄没有浪费时间，就地吞服炼化。
结果没让他失望，这五颗丹药的效果，比之前的六颗黄阶六品玄气丹强了一倍以上！
此时，他的玄气达到了现有境界的一半左右。
距离进阶，大概还需10颗左右的同级别丹药。
“谁会是下一个幸运儿呢？”
林玄走出山谷，继续前行。
接下来，他却没有找到什么妖兽，也没遭遇什么武者。
偶有几道身影出现，也都不作停留，在视线尽头掠过。
天色渐晚，林玄在一处石洞中停留。
一夜时间过去了，天刚蒙蒙亮，继续向前进发。
翻过几座山岭之后，前方有打斗声传来，听起来还很激烈。
林玄循声而往，来到一座小山上。
稍作观察，原来是一群武者在围观赌斗。
围观的一共七人，三男四女，年纪跟林玄差不多大。

内圈交手的，是两个男弟子，一个青袍，一个蓝袍。
这些人穿着不同式样的武袍，并不是天玄宗弟子。
林玄想起来，葬剑山对面有另外几个宗门和武道家族。
这些人，也许是那边过来的。
他们也看到了林玄，但只是冷冷瞥了一眼，便把目光收了回去。
看起来，似乎没什么恶意。
林玄走了过去，打算看看热闹。
几个回合之后，场中二人突然停止交手。
“不打了，跟小孩过家家似的，就这几个人下注，也赢不了多少灵币。”
“哪里有大点的赌斗场，能让咱们尽兴的？”
“别说，还真有一个好去处，据说那里赌斗奖励非常丰厚，但要有真本事才行，否则连门票都赚不回来。”
content_en:
There are five Xuanqi Pills inside, all of which are ordinary items issued by Tianxuan Sect. Perhaps those younger brothers respected Ding Tie, and now he has taken advantage of them.
Lin Xuan once wanted these pills, but now he has no interest in them.
Only after going through the furnace of heaven and earth for sacrifice can it enter his mouth.
Lin Xuan put away the pills and continued heading into the mountains.
In a secluded valley, he spent a few breaths refining five Xuanqi Pills and obtained five Nine-Path Golden Pattern Pills.
"The ninth-grade yellow grade gold-patterned profound energy pill!"
Lin Xuan wasted no time and swallowed and refined it on the spot.
The result did not disappoint him. The effect of these five pills was more than twice as strong as the previous six Huang-level sixth-grade profound energy pills!
At this time, his profound energy reached about half of its current level.
It takes about 10 pills of the same level to advance.
"Who will be the next lucky guy?"
Lin Xuan walked out of the valley and continued to move forward.
Next, he didn't find any monsters or encounter any warriors.
Occasionally, a few figures appeared, but they did not stop and passed at the end of the line of sight.
It was getting late, and Lin Xuan stopped in a cave.
The night passed and it was just dawn, so we continued to move forward.
After climbing over several mountains, the sound of fighting came from ahead, and it sounded fierce.
Lin Xuan followed the sound and came to a hill.
After a little observation, it turned out that a group of warriors were watching the gambling fight.
There were seven people watching, three men and four women, about the same age as Lin Xuan.
The ones fighting in the inner circle were two male disciples, one in green robe and one in blue robe.
These people wore different styles of martial robes and were not disciples of the Tianxuan Sect.
Lin Xuan remembered that there were several other sects and martial arts families opposite Burial Sword Mountain.
These people may have come from over there.
They also saw Lin Xuan, but they only glanced at him coldly and then looked away.
It doesn't seem like there's any malicious intent.
Lin Xuan walked over, intending to take a look at the excitement.
After a few rounds, the two men suddenly stopped fighting.
"If we don't fight, it's like children playing house. Just these few people betting won't win many spiritual coins."
"Where is there a bigger gambling arena where we can have fun?"
"Don't tell me, there is really a good place. It is said that the rewards for gambling there are very generous, but you must have real skills, otherwise you won't even be able to earn back the tickets."
